title: Permanent SMTP failure marks peer down unnecessarily
description: relay_queue.rs try_deliver_one: on permanent delivery failure (5xx), peer is marked down for the full backoff. A 5xx means message content rejected, not peer unavailable. Subsequent valid messages are delayed for the entire backoff window. Operators will file reports about delayed delivery after one bounced message. Fix: mark peer down only on transient (connection-level) failures, not 5xx rejections.
